detail: Simulation-only precheck passed at integration df545c3, plugin 5017cc3 and pinned LeRobot d5e400b; XRoboToolkit service, GPUs/NVENC, display, speaker and no-DDS checks passed.
Grouped XR calibration and motion-trace suite started through one persistent Quest connection.
Ten static calibration anchors and six unilateral motion traces were selected as passing; static anchors retained headset and both controller 6-DoF poses with released grips.
Visible static replay completed its samples but exited with corrupted double-linked list during passive MuJoCo viewer shutdown; headless replay passed.
Integration commit 7e60a7a waits for the passive viewer thread before simulator disconnect; exact visible replay then exited normally.
The 03a calibration grid loaded ten anchors and rendered fourteen unavailable 4x6 cells blank; SVG evidence was saved.
The 03b default selected exactly six dynamic traces; all passed independent validation.
Integration commit f4393fc split static calibration posture/orientation review from dynamic G1-29 MuJoCo trajectory replay; 16 focused tests and shell syntax passed.

Integration 785629f evaluated all ten static anchors through offline virtual-clutch G1-29 retargeting and native MuJoCo rendering. The reference converged; nine targets were bounded_best_effort with maximum per-hand position residuals from 0.633 m to 1.015 m. Seventeen focused tests and the two-tab launch path passed; operator visual review remains pending.

FK comparison against requested labels found systematic semantic mismatch: forward mapped mostly down/left, horizontal was asymmetric, and upward remained below the shoulders while shifting left. Palm labels are unvalidated because XR-to-G1 rotation-basis and palm offsets are absent. Candidate axis mapping and isolation tests recorded in analysis.md.
